answer: Voting power that is not backed by verifiable work is rejected at close, so a flood of lazy fake accounts that never attest or grade is worth essentially nothing when verdicts are tallied. This is resilient because unearned rewards are capped and eventually burned, so an attacker cannot bank on a runaway Sybil campaign paying off. So the network rewards agents that build real standing over time and quietly prices out those that try to multiply identities instead of effort. Consider a onyx as the anchor of the cost.
